name: B10-0295/2025 (ECR) – Media freedom in Georgia, particularly the case of Mzia Amaglobeli
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on media freedom in Georgia, particularly the case of Mzia Amaglobeli
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of Mzia Amaglobeli, a Georgian media director arrested during a protest and facing up to seven years in prison. It asks Georgia's authorities to stop intimidating and attacking journalists, to investigate police violence, and to let the media work freely. It also wants the European Union to sanction Georgian leaders it blames for democratic backsliding and ties to Russia. This is a request, not a change in law.

- Nothing changes yet; the Parliament is only asking Georgia and the EU to act.
- It targets Georgia's government, its judges, and media owners loyal to it.
- Next, EU member states decide whether to impose the sanctions.
